newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks add to gains, NYSE sets trading curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks add to gains, NYSE sets trading curbs.

text.p: U.S. stocks added to their afternoon gains on Friday, with a drop in long-term interest rates inspiring market bulls.

The Dow was up about 54 points to 7831, triggering the New York Stock Exchange's curbs on index-arbitrage trades at 1441 EDT/1841 GMT. Traders said they expected late-day volatility tied to "triple witching" options and futures expirations.

The long bond was up 15/32, its yield dropping to 6.64 percent from Thursday's close at 6.68 percent. Wall Street was awaiting news on a possible settlement between U.S. states and the tobacco industry.
